children: Palm oil rose, with the Bursa Malaysia Derivatives contract for November delivery rising 39 ringgit to 4,853 ringgit a ton. Despite concerns over rising stockpiles and slowing export demand, higher crude oil prices and persistent worries about yields and future production related to El Nino weather conditions may have helped cushion the downside, Kenanga Futures said in a note.
